title: Watersound Crossings C-428 100 S Bridge Lane
h1: Watersound Crossings C-428 100 S Bridge Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gated Community with on-site Security- Great views of the Gulf and natural sand dunes- Fantastic porch spaces- Pool and beach are just yards away- Free Wi-Fi- Stainless steel appliances- Access to Community Outdoor Fireplace- TVs in Every Bedroom- Gulf Views from Living Room, Kitchen and Two Bedrooms- From March 1st to October 31st, the rental of this property includes one beach -service set (2 beach chairs and 1umbrella)- Private deeded beach access- Free WiFi- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout*This property comes with 1 designated parking space and 1 first-come first-serve parking space. Please note first come first serve parking is limited and not guaranteed. This condo permits a maximum of 2 vehicles through the community security gate.*Beginning in March 2025 and continuing through 2026, the WaterSound Crossings condominiums will undergo an extensive exterior refurbishment project. During this period, residents and guests should expect significant construction activity, including the boarding of windows and restricted access to balconies in affected buildings. These measures are necessary to ensure safety and facilitate the successful completion of the work.DETAILS: Unbeatable coastal views and just steps from the beach in gorgeous Watersound! This beautiful home features 3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms and sleeping accommodations for 7 guests.Inside the main living area, guests will enjoy the subtle coastal decor and beautiful hardwood floors throughout. Large windows surround the living and dining areas, allowing natural light to pour into the space. The living room offers a plush sofa, comfortable arm chairs, and a large mounted flat-screen television - perfect for a vacation movie night! In the adjacent dining area, six guests can enjoy seating at the dining table, and three additional guests can be seated at the breakfast bar nearby. Granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and tons of storage space await in the gourmet kitchen, where guests can enjoy preparing exquisite meals together. The balcony boasts incredible views of the sparkling emerald waters and sugar white sand beach - a perfect place to start the day with a cup of coffee and the stunning sunrise.Guests in the primary bedroom enjoy a luxurious upholstered king bed, a private balcony with breathtaking beach views, and an en suite bathroom with a glass-front shower, dual vanities and a spa tub. The queen bed guestroom offers abundant natural light from a wall of windows, exquisite gulf views, and a private bathroom with a single vanity and glass-front shower. The third bedroom in this home features a beautiful twin daybed, a twin-over-twin bunkbed, and a private bathroom with a shower/tub combo.Enjoy all that 30A has to offer with our amazing coastal culture - including the best dining, shopping, and experiences around! This beautiful home promises to make your next 30A getaway a vacation of a lifetime. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 8):- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower And Tub Separate- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower- Guest Bedroom: One Day Bed, One Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower/Tub Combo- Living Room: Queen Sleeper*Weddings or parties/groups of people or guest of guest are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.
